scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces && npm run db:build
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run contract:check --workspace @iop/web && npm test --workspaces && npm run db:test:unit
scripts.openapi: npm run build && npm run openapi --workspace @iop/api
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e --workspace @iop/web
scripts.db:provision: npm run db:build && node infra/database/dist/cli.js provision
scripts.db:seed:organization: npm run db:build && node infra/database/dist/cli.js seed-organization
scripts.db:seed:site: npm run db:build && node infra/database/dist/cli.js seed-site
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:build && node infra/database/dist/cli.js migrate
scripts.test:database: npm run db:build && node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config infra/database/jest.config.cjs --runInBand
